scenarios.title: A｜询问原因
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现自己只告诉过好友 Jamie 的私事，被其他人知道了。玩家决定直接问她。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Can I ask you something? Did you tell anyone about what I told you last week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you something? Did you tell anyone about what I told you last week?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I heard that Sam knows about what happened. Did you tell him?

feedback.naturalExpression: I heard that Sam knows about what happened. Did you tell him?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I thought that conversation was private. Did you mention it to someone?

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought that conversation was private. Did you mention it to someone?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need you to be honest with me. Did you tell anyone?

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to be honest with me. Did you tell anyone?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Why did you tell everyone my secret?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you something? Did you tell anyone about what I told you last week?
feedback.explanation: 在还没确认事实前直接下结论

turns.text: I only told Sam. I didn’t think it was a big deal.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: But why did you tell him?

feedback.naturalExpression: But why did you tell him?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What made you think it was okay to share that?

feedback.naturalExpression: What made you think it was okay to share that?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I told you because I trusted you. Why didn’t you ask me first?

feedback.naturalExpression: I told you because I trusted you. Why didn’t you ask me first?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Did you realize I didn’t want anyone else to know?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you realize I didn’t want anyone else to know?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I honestly didn’t think you’d mind. I’m sorry.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I wish you’d checked with me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wish you’d checked with me first.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I just need you to understand why I’m upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I just need you to understand why I’m upset.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I appreciate the apology, but that wasn’t yours to share.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology, but that wasn’t yours to share.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜表达受伤
scenarios.setting: 在“朋友泄露自己的秘密”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“表达受伤”。

turns.text: I’m really sorry. I didn’t mean to hurt you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know you probably didn’t mean to, but I feel really betrayed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you probably didn’t mean to, but I feel really betrayed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What hurts most is that I trusted you with something very personal.

feedback.naturalExpression: What hurts most is that I trusted you with something very personal.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not just angry. I’m hurt that you shared something I told you in confidence.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not just angry. I’m hurt that you shared something I told you in confidence.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It’s going to be hard for me to trust you with personal things again.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s going to be hard for me to trust you with personal things again.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You broke my heart.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I know you probably didn’t mean to, but I feel really betrayed.
feedback.explanation: 通常用于非常强烈的情感伤害，在普通友情冲突里可能过重

turns.text: I understand. I made a mistake.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: It wasn’t just a mistake to me. It was something really private.

feedback.naturalExpression: It wasn’t just a mistake to me. It was something really private.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need you to take this seriously.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to take this seriously.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand that you’re sorry, but I can’t just pretend it didn’t happen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that you’re sorry, but I can’t just pretend it didn’t happen.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need some time before I’m ready to move past this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need some time before I’m ready to move past this.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Thank you for apologizing. I just need some space right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for apologizing. I just need some space right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I appreciate you saying that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I appreciate you saying that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜重新考虑这段友情
scenarios.setting: 几天后，两人再次谈起这件事。

turns.text: Are we okay? You’ve barely talked to me since everything happened.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Honestly, I’m not sure yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I’m not sure yet.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I care about you, but what happened really changed how I feel about our friendship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I care about you, but what happened really changed how I feel about our friendship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m still trying to decide whether I can trust you again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still trying to decide whether I can trust you again.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think I need some distance for a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I need some distance for a while.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I don’t want one mistake to ruin our friendship.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Neither do I, but trust is really important to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Neither do I, but trust is really important to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand, but I can’t force myself to be okay with it immediately.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I can’t force myself to be okay with it immediately.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe we can rebuild the trust, but it’ll take time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we can rebuild the trust, but it’ll take time.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t know if things can go back to how they were before.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know if things can go back to how they were before.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: So what do you want to do?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: For now, I think I just need some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: For now, I think I just need some space.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I still want to be friends, but I need clearer boundaries.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still want to be friends, but I need clearer boundaries.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think we should take a step back and see how things feel later.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we should take a step back and see how things feel later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Honestly, I don’t think I want to continue this friendship.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I don’t think I want to continue this friendship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
